en.headline: HKUMed to host first World Health Summit Regional Meeting in Hong Kong
en.dek: The faculty will organise the meeting from 7 to 9 May 2027 at the Convention and Exhibition Centre under the theme Health Across Borders, expecting about 2,000 participants.
body: The LKS Faculty of Medicine of the University of Hong Kong received the baton to host the World Health Summit Regional Meeting 2027 at the summit’s opening night in Berlin on 11 October.

The meeting, the first of its kind to be held in Hong Kong, will take place from 7 to 9 May 2027 at the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre. It is themed Health Across Borders and is expected to draw about 2,000 participants from governments, multilateral agencies, academia and other sectors.

Professor Chak-sing Lau, Dean of Medicine and incoming International President of the World Health Summit 2027, said the faculty was ready to harness Hong Kong’s role as a super connector. The programme will include more than 40 sessions across five thematic tracks covering equity, the digital era, partnerships, science and innovation, and multi-sector policy.

zh.headline: 港大醫學院將主辦世界衛生峰會2027年區域會議
zh.dek: 會議將於明年5月7日至9日在會展中心舉行，主題為「健康無界」，預計吸引約2000人參與，是香港首次主辦。
body: 香港大學李嘉誠醫學院於10月11日在德國柏林舉行的世界衛生峰會開幕之夜上，從內羅畢代表手中接過主辦2027年區域會議的接力棒。
是次會議將於2027年5月7日至9日在香港會議展覽中心舉行，主題為「健康無界」，預計吸引約2000名來自政府、國際組織、學術界及其他界別的參與者，是香港首次主辦這項國際衛生對話平台。
港大醫學院院長兼世界衛生峰會2027年國際主席劉澤星表示，學院準備好發揮香港作為超級聯繫人的角色。會議將設逾40場專題會議，涵蓋醫衛公平、數碼時代的健康、夥伴合作、科學與創新，以及多部門協作的衛生政策五大主題。
